text: Maharashtra Dy CM Ajit Pawar Killed In Plane Crash; Last Rites To Be Held Today; Preparations OnMaharashtra Deputy Chief Minister and Nationalist Congress Party chief Ajit Pawar was killed in a plane crash on Wednesday morning after a chartered aircraft travelling from Mumbai to Baramati made a crash landing around 8:45 am, according to the DGCA. The aircraft crashed near the runway threshold at Baramati, claiming five lives, including Pawar, two crew members, a personal security officer and an attendant on board. Following the tragic news, Supriya Sule visited Ajit Pawar’s family, with emotional moments witnessed at the residence.
